pages.text: “A treasure nurtured by ice and snow, containing the miracle of life.”$(br2)Snow Lotus Tea is a rare and powerful beverage made from dried snow lotus petals and sugar. The tea is crystal clear with a faint blue tint. Drinking it grants high-level health regeneration and removes the Wither effect, allowing travelers to recover quickly.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Snow Lotus Tea, $(br)boil dried snow lotus petals with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed after battle or when afflicted by the Wither effect, rapidly restoring vitality.

Upon drinking Snow Lotus Tea, travelers gain high-level health regeneration and have the Wither effect removed, restoring their condition quickly.$(br)This is a rare and precious recovery tea, perfect for emergency situations.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
